description: Startup credits for the given vendors, and whether you qualify based on your bank, incorporation provider, accelerator or funding. Example: {"vendor_ids":["supabase","posthog"],"founder":{"gateways":["mercury"]}}.

founder.description: Optional company details used only to find startup perks.

existing_customer_of.description: Vendor ids you already pay (new-customer perks are excluded).

gateways.description: Perk gateways you belong to, e.g. ["mercury", "stripe_atlas", "yc"].

name: find_perks

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

completeness.description: On plan and project results: complete, complete_with_assumptions, incomplete or needs_clarification, with the reasons. Say plainly when it is not complete.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

project.description: On results about a saved project: its id and the context version the answer was computed on. Pass both back in follow-up calls.

title: Find startup perks
